title: Analysis code for: Comprehensive mapping of essential-gene interactions in M. tuberculosis
description: Code and a runnable example dataset for the probabilistic genetic-interaction analysis in Kresse, Sayegh, et al., "Comprehensive mapping of essential-gene interactions in M. tuberculosis" (Nature, accepted). Includes the per-guide-pair two-line fitness model, the per-screen and joint Bayesian Normal/Uniform mixture models, and a 15-gene example dataset that runs end to end from pooled count tables to gene x gene interaction matrices.
notes: Isaac J. Kresse and Natalie Y. Sayegh contributed equally to this work.
